_doc: Point-in-time fact sheet for MAR retrospectives (retro/build_mar.py). Every value is tied to a source and becomes visible only on or after that source's 'published' date. A filing accepted after the 16:00 ET close is dated the next trading day. Generated from the transcribed raw figures; every growth rate, margin and rule-T value is computed from them, and the builder re-derives them. Per-share figures published before a split or stock dividend carry their own publication date ('eps_published', 'shares_published'); a split applies from its 'applies' date, the later of its ex-date and the first filing that states it.

history_vintages.why: Marriott: 'Consistent with our focus on management and franchising, we own very few of our lodging properties'; 'We operate or franchise 2,832 lodging properties worldwide, with 513,832 rooms as of year-end 2006'; 'The lodging industry is highly competitive, which may impact our ability to compete successfully with other hotel and timeshare properties for customers'; 'The profitability of the hotels, vacation timeshare resorts and corporate apartments that we operate or franchise may be adversely affected by a number of factors, including: ... international, national and regional economic and geopolitical conditions'; and 'if the amount of sales made through Internet intermediaries increases significantly, our business and profitability may be harmed' (its own FY2006 10-K): a hotel management and franchise system whose fees follow the revenues and profits of its hotels through the economy, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it
